Measure both shadows at the same time. Move the slider to see how the shadow lengths change while the tree height stays the same.

clips.send: Draw a line through the center O and each vertex. Multiply each distance from O by the same positive number k. In Basic mode, each image vertex stays on the same ray from O as its original. Corresponding angles match, and every side length scales by k. Similar triangles have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides. Perimeter is the sum of the sides, so it scales by k. The base and the height each scale by k, so area scales by k squared . When k equals 1, the triangles are congruent and similar.

clips.send: Lay a flat mirror on level ground between you and the upright tree. The incoming and reflected rays make equal angles with the normal (the dashed line perpendicular to the mirror), so they also make equal angles with the mirror surface. When the ray reaches your eye, those matching angles and the right angles give AA similarity. The ray passes below your eye. Move farther from the mirror.

clips.send: 两个夹角都是直角。改变 DF，使两组对应边的比相等。 按对应顶点的顺序写相似式。若 ABC ∽ DEF，则 A 对应 D、B 对应 E、C 对应 F，因此 AB 对应 DE，依此类推。

clips.send: 在水平地面上，把平面镜放在人和直立的树之间。入射角和反射角都从法线（垂直于镜面的虚线）量起，两角相等。因此，两条光线与镜面所成的角也相等。反射光线到达眼睛时，根据这对等角和两个直角，可由 AA 判定两个三角形相似。 反射光线从眼睛下方经过。向远离平面镜的方向移动。

clips.send: 连接位似中心 O 与各顶点，把距离都乘同一个正数 k。在基础模式中，像的顶点与原顶点在从 O 出发的同一条射线上。对应角相等，各组对应边的比均为 k。 相似三角形的对应角相等，对应边成比例。周长是三条边的和，所以乘 k。面积用到底和高，两者都乘 k，所以面积乘 k 的平方 。当 k 等于 1 时，两个三角形全等，也相似。
